hypothesis: The ScopedAliases class fails to correctly resolve nested aliases because it performs a simple string replacement of the alias name within a qualified type name, rather than correctly expanding the alias definition.
prediction: The implementation of AliasedTypeNode.applyAlias in ScopedAliases.java will show that it uses a simple string replacement instead of replacing the alias prefix with the full qualified name of the aliased object.
experiment_rationale: The bug report and the failing test case indicate a failure in type resolution during alias expansion. The fix diff shows that the logic for expanding aliases was changed from a simple string replacement to a more robust replacement that uses the full qualified name of the alias definition.
reasoning_summary: The defect is in the procedural logic of how aliases are expanded in the AST. The original implementation was insufficient for nested/qualified aliases, requiring a change in the algorithm used to transform the type node string. This fits the Algorithm/Method ODC type as it is a local procedural correction to the alias expansion logic.
